resources.string: Keep up to %1$d terminals. Close an unused session first.
Could not start the terminal. Retry or open another session.
The shell was killed (137). Check background permissions and system logs. If they show Trimming phantom processes, adjust Android child process limits before restarting the session.

Shell exited (143, usually SIGTERM). Check the session exit record in Logs and diagnostics, then review the battery exemption and child process limit in Settings → Permissions. The exit code alone does not identify who stopped the process.
